rows.en: Yamato: "...ya... Touya!
Huuuuuh... TOUYAAAA!!"
Touya: "Uwaaaaaah?! Wh-what?!"
Yamato: "Wake up! Wake up! Something terrible's happened!"
Touya: "Ugh... Don't yell right in my ear..."
Yamato: "Forget that, nyow! This is serious!
Leone collapsed!"
Touya: "Collapsed...?"
Yamato: "Yes! They're examining her in the infirmary,
but they say she's in a very dangerous condition, nyow..."
Touya: "What?!"
Yamato: "So hurry!"
Touya: "Y-yeah..."
Kasumi: "...Oh, Touya-chan!"
Touya: "How is she?"
Arthur: "They're treating her now...
But I can hardly say she's doing well."
Paldia: "She was helping me prepare breakfast
when she suddenly collapsed..."
Gabon: "...O-oh... Hey..."
Touya: "How's Leone? She's okay, right?"
Gabon: "Y-yeah... She's stable for now."
Ai: "For now? You mean there's a chance
she could collapse again?"
Gabon: "No... It's worse than that."
Touya: "What do you mean?"
Gabon: "...Leone's body is undergoing necrosis."
Ai: "'Necrosis'?"
Gabon: "Her cells are dying, and her body tissue is breaking down."
Kasumi: "Th-that means..."
Gabon: "It's progressing slowly, but surely."
Touya: "Hey! Can't you do something?!"
Gabon: "With our current medical technology, saving her is... I'm sorry."
Ai: "You're... kidding, right...?"
Gabon: "...I wish I were."
Kasumi: "No..."
Touya: "...Can I talk to Leone?"
Gabon: "No... She's sleeping right now."
Touya: "...Gabon, is Leone really already..."
Gabon: "Yes. I don't expect her to be bedridden,
but it is progressing. Still, I'm a doctor too.
I'm not giving up on her."
Touya: "Yeah... Please."
Kasumi: "Touya-chan!"
Ai: "Hey, what do you mean, Leone collapsed?!"
Touya: "...I don't know. It was so sudden.
She was fine right up until it happened..."
Kasumi: "Touya-chan, you look pale.
Have you... not slept?"
Touya: "Well, no... But I'm okay..."
Kasumi: "Don't push yourself. We're here now,
so get some rest, Touya-chan. Please."
Touya: "I told you, I'm okay..."
Gabon: "...O-oh... Hey..."
Touya: "How's Leone? She's okay, right?"
Gabon: "Y-yeah... She's stable for now."
Ai: "For now? You mean there's a chance
she could collapse again?"
Gabon: "...Yes. If Lyle hadn't said anything, I doubt we'd have known
Leone was an artificially created human.
It's remarkable work, but they couldn't make a perfect human..."
Kasumi: "What do you mean by that?"
Gabon: "I suspect Leone's body needs regular treatment
to regenerate its tissue.
I should have realized it sooner..."
Touya: "Just tell me what the hell that means!"
Gabon: "...Leone's body is undergoing necrosis."
Ai: "'Necrosis'?"
Gabon: "Her cells are dying, and her body tissue is breaking down."
Kasumi: "Th-that means..."
Gabon: "It's progressing slowly, but surely."
Touya: "Hey! Can't you do something?!"
Gabon: "With our current medical technology, saving her is... I'm sorry.
And at this stage, there's no hope of regeneration.
Probably not even for Bernst..."
Ai: "You're... kidding, right...?"
Gabon: "...I wish I were."
Kasumi: "No..."
Touya: "...Can I talk to Leone?"
Gabon: "Yes."
Kasumi: "Oh, Touya-cha... Huh? Ai-chan?"
Ai: "Let's leave the two of them alone for now.
Not for Touya. For Leone.
He's the one she trusts most..."
Kasumi: "Ai-chan..."
Leone: "...Oh, Touya..."
Touya: "..."
Leone: "...I see. You found out..."
Touya: "Why? Why didn't you tell us...?
Your life is at stake!"
Leone: "Because you said I was one of you...
Because you said you believed in me..."
Touya: "Leone..."
Leone: "I... I don't regret it at all.
All the time I've spent with you, right up to today...
It was so much fun... I was so happy."
Touya: "Isn't there... anything we can do...?"
Leone: "I'm awful... Making you worry so much, Touya.
But I wanted to spend even one moment
longer with you."
Touya: "..."
Leone: "...I love you, Touya..."
Touya: "Leone..."
Leone: "Ehehehe... I finally said it..."
Hug Leone.
Stay silent.
Touya: "..."
Leone: "...I guess this is a burden on you?
Of course it is... Oh, don't worry about it...
It's just how I feel...
Even if there's someone else you have your eye on,
my feelings won't change. So... Just for a little while,
is it okay if I keep loving you?"
Touya: "Leone..."
Leone: "...S-sorry... I'm feeling a little tired.
I'm going to rest for a bit..."
Leone: "T-Touya...?"
Touya: "..."
Leone: "..."
Touya: "..."
Leone: "This is... a little embarrassing."
Touya: "Leone, I feel..."
Leone: "...No. If you're any kinder to me,
I'll fall apart. Just having you hug me
makes my heart race this much... See?"
Touya: "H-hey..."
Leone: "Ehehehehe... I'm sorry...
I want to stay with you longer... But I'm a little tired...
I'm going to rest for a bit..."
Touya: "H-hey, Leone?!"
Leone: "Hehehe... I'm okay.
I'm really just tired. Thank you for worrying about me."
Touya: "O-okay... Well, then..."
Leone: "Yeah... Bye-bye..."
Kasumi: "Touya-chan..."
Touya: "...It's okay. She's sleeping now.
...Gabon, is Leone really already..."
Gabon: "Yes. I don't expect her to be bedridden,
but it is progressing. Still, I'm a doctor too.
I'm not giving up on her."
Touya: "Yeah... Please."
Ai: "Oh, Ymir... Are you okay now?"
Ymir: "Y-yes. This isn't the time to give in to grief.
Stopping Dr. Debish's plan comes first.
More importantly, is it true Leone collapsed?!"
Ai: "Y-yeah..."
Melvi: "She's okay, right? She'll get better soon, won't she?"
Touya: "..."
Melvi: "No..."
Gabon: "Anyway, leave Leone to me.
You lot concentrate on stopping them.
I'm sure that's what Leone would want too."
Touya: "...Let's go."
Ymir: "Touya..."
Ai: "Huh? Where's Ymir?"
Touya: "O-oh... She said to go on ahead."
Ai: "Hmm... Then Ymir's okay."
Yamato: "Huh? Why do you think so?"
Ai: "Because there's no way Touya would leave someone
when they're feeling down, is there?"
Yamato: "I see, nyow."
Clovis: "...So, what approach did you use?"
Touya: "Why the hell do you look so eager to hear?!"
Arthur: "I'd be very interested to hear it myself."
Fain: "Y-you didn't..."
Touya: "You guys..."
Kasumi: "Oh... Ymir..."
Ymir: "Oh... Everyone..."
Clovis: "Perfect timing. If Touya won't answer,
we'll just have to ask you."
Touya: "Hey, I told you..."
Clovis: "...So, how was yesterday?"
Ymir: "Yesterday...? Oh..."
Clovis: "That's right. Last night."
Ymir: "..."
Clovis: "Oh-ho! I see, I see..."
Touya: "No, I told you, that's not what happened..."
Kasumi: "..."
Touya: "Ugh..."
Celica: "..."
Touya: "No, I told you..."
Aurelie: "..."
Melissa: "Oh...?"
Touya: "Your... eyes aren't smiling..."
Ai: "Oh, do excuse me!"
Arthur: "It must be hard being so popular.
But it shows how much they care about you.
Make sure you settle things properly in the end..."
Ai: "Oh, Touya. I just saw Ymir.
She seems to be okay now."
Yamato: "Melvi worked so hard to cheer her up.
Maybe it shows Ymir herself is getting stronger, nyow."
Ai: "Hmm... So, what did you do, Touya?"
Touya: "Huh? What did I...? Nothing, really..."
Ai: "That's not like you."
Yamato: "Huh? Why?"
Ai: "Because there's no way Touya would leave someone
when they're feeling down, is there?"
Yamato: "I see, nyow."
Ai: "Anyway, Ymir seems to be feeling better.
Now there's only one thing left to do..."
Yamato: "Face Dr. Debish."
Touya: "Yeah. We didn't settle things last time,
but this time, we'll finish it for good."
Ivel: "...It seems the Zigrim Republic has just
made a formal proposal to the Kingdom of Agarthia
to conclude a peace treaty."
Ymir: "I see... I hope this will
bring the war to an end..."
Celica: "I doubt we can make a world without war.
But we can work to prevent wars from starting.
Maybe now is the time to do just that."
Arthur: "As long as we cling to the barriers between countries,
humanity will never be free of conflict."
Clovis: "In the end, we couldn't find a way
to settle this without fighting either. But knowing that's wrong
is what lets us take the next step."
Aurelie: "That sounds like you're making excuses for yourself."
Clovis: "You can't keep fighting unless you justify yourself somehow.
And when you gain 'power,' like we have this time,
you also have to struggle with 'arrogance' and 'self-restraint.'
That's no small task."
Aurelie: "Oh? And have you won that fight?"
Clovis: "The only thing that could defeat me
is the tears of a beautiful woman."
Aurelie: "Sure, sure. Whatever you say.
...Anyway, whatever reasons we give,
there's no such thing as a righteous battle.
Let someone else pass judgment on us.
We'll just do what we can."
Ai: "Exactly! There's no point overthinking it.
Let's just go in and get this over with!"
Ivel: "When you say it, I almost believe
you really can. Still, don't let your guard down.
Our opponent is Dr. Debish, after all..."
Ai: "Okaaay."
Arthur: "Well then, shall we be going?"
Clovis: "...Yeah."
Ymir: "Lady Ivel... We'll be off, then."
Ivel: "Yes, off you go.
...And... Follow the path you believe in."
Ymir: "...Yes."
Ivel: "...Well then, Valga, Rishuna.
I'm counting on you."
Rishuna: "Yes. I'll do what little I can to help."
Valga: "Though I do hope we won't be needed.
Exertion is hard on these old bones."
Rishuna: "Valga?!"
Touya: "Don't worry. We'll settle this ourselves.
We won't trouble you two."
Valga: "Good. That's the spirit.
Even with the slimmest chance of victory, if you give up from the start,
you'll end up with nothing in your hands."
Clovis: "Hey, is our chance of winning that slim?"
Valga: "Hohohoho! It's a figure of speech. A figure of speech."
Touya: "All right... Let's go!"
Kasumi: "Let's do our best."
Sharl: "...Have you finished the embroidery?"
Doris: "Yes. I haven't handed it over yet, though."
Sharl: "Does that mean you have it with you now?"
Doris: "Yes. I was told not to do anything unnecessary.
Though I suppose that wasn't the only reason..."
Sharl: "..."
Doris: "..."
Sharl: "...I hope you can hand it over safely."
Doris: "Yes..."
Sharl: "Then it's about time we went.
Those people are with them.
It will only be a matter of time before they cross the 'Sorge Field.'"
Touya: "...Come to think of it, how are we going to get past
that whatsit barrier around Alterias Valley?"
Celica: "The 'Sorge Field.' Don't worry about that.
I can't exactly say I anticipated this, but...
I made a barrier-breaching device: 'Charge Buddy No. 3.'"
Touya: "...What happened to Nos. 1 and 2?"
Celica: "Never mind the little details.
I've installed it on Liebhofen, so we're all set."
Valga: "We helped her with it too."
Yamato: "I don't knyow what it does, but how did you find
the time to make something like that, nyow?"
Celica: "Well... I haven't slept, thanks to that."
Valga: "I had a good night's sleep myself."
Rishuna: "Valga, you don't have to comment
on every little thing..."
Valga: "And here I thought I was showing restraint..."
Celica: "Anyway, there's nothing to worry about.
Let's go."
Yamato: "Well then, shall we get going?"
Touya: "Yeah... Next time we come back here,
it'll be to get our things. So we can leave this ship."
Yamato: "Yeah. Let's make sure we come back."
Touya: "...Come in."
Touya: "Hm? What's wrong?"
Ymir: "...Touya..."
Touya: "Wh-what is it?"
Yamato: "M-maybe I... should go on ahead, nyow...?"
Ymir: "No, Yamato. You stay too."
Yamato: "O-okay..."
Ymir: "...I... I've been thinking...
What am I really doing?
I send everyone out to risk their lives,
then watch the battle from the safety of the bridge...
Is that all I can do...?"
Touya: "...That's not true.
It's because you and the others back us up, Ymir,
that we can concentrate on fighting without worrying."
Ymir: "...I've thought that too. I've tried to believe it...
But I can't.
After the battle at the ruined research institute,
when you all disappeared, I felt just how powerless I was.
The next Matriarch? Chief Alchemical Scholar? What good was any of that...?
Everyone fussed over me, calling me a once-in-a-century talent.
But I couldn't even tell you how I felt.
And when you went off to fight with your life on the line,
I couldn't do a thing...
When you went missing,
I believed the worst couldn't have happened. I didn't want to think about it.
But I kept imagining the worst, and I felt as if
the fear would crush my heart..."
Touya: "Ymir..."
Ymir: "I regretted it so much... My heart hurt so badly,
and whenever I thought about you, I couldn't stop crying...
Only then did I finally understand.
I really do care for you, Touya.
I love you...
Of course, I'd had feelings for you before that.
But part of me kept hesitating.
What if I confessed and you turned me down?
I was sure I'd never recover.
But I was just afraid of getting hurt
and running away. Just like always..."
Touya: "..."
Ymir: "...Last night, when I cried against your chest,
your kindness wrapped itself around me...
That's when I decided I wouldn't run away anymore.
So... So, please. Let me aboard Rayblade."
Touya: "Is that why you went to Miyasco and Celica?"
Ymir: "Yes. I was still practicing then,
and I wasn't confident. That's why I couldn't tell you properly..."
Touya: "But..."
Ymir: "You know, I've been rated
as having high pilot aptitude."
Touya: "What?! H-hey, don't joke about..."
Ymir: "I'm serious. I practiced piloting for this.
I've been rated as having high pilot aptitude, you know."
Yamato: "But no matter how much you've practiced...
real combat is different from practice, you knyow?"
Ymir: "Of course I know that.
I know I'm asking too much.
But I don't want to regret anything anymore.
I can't just do nothing for the person I love
while he's fighting with his life on the line.
Please listen to this one selfish request. It'll be my first and last...
Please, let me be with you."
Yamato: "Ymir... You care about Touya that much..."
Touya: "..."
...All right.
Ymir: "Touya..."
Touya: "I'm sorry. I never realized how much you were struggling,
how much you were hurting..."
Ymir: "No... I... I..."
Touya: "H-hey, don't cry..."
Ymir: "S-sorry... I can't seem to help it...
Ehehehe... I must look awful..."
Touya: "No, you don't.
Ymir... Let's make sure we win. And then..."
Ymir: "And then...?"
Touya: "Let's pick up where we left off last night."
Ymir: "Where we left off...? Oh..."
Touya: "Just kidding..."
Ymir: "...I'd like that..."
Touya: "Huh?! No, I was joking..."
Ymir: "...If it's you, Touya... I'd like that..."
Touya: "Ymir..."
Ymir: "Touya..."
Yamato: "U-um... I'm terribly sorry
to interrupt you two, nyow, but...
we really should get ready..."
Ymir: "?!"
Touya: "Huh?!"
Ymir: "...Y-yes, you're right..."
Touya: "Y-yeah... Sh-shall we go...?"
Ymir: "...O-oh..."
Touya: "I'm glad you feel that way...
But I just can't put you in danger."
Ymir: "..."
Yamato: "Th-that's right. There are things
only you can do, Ymir, you knyow."
Ymir: "...Huh?"
Yamato: "If you come with us,
who's going to protect Liebhofen? Even if we win,
what will we do if there's nyowhere to come back to?
And... Knowing someone is waiting for us
gives us a reason to come home, you knyow?"
Ymir: "...Sniff... Th-thank you...
You're right. I... I was forcing my feelings on you...
I'm sorry..."
Touya: "N-no, you don't have anything to apologize for, Ymir."
Ymir: "I'm sorry...
Touya... Do your best..."
Yamato: "Ymir..."
Touya: "..."
Sisk: "We'll make contact with the 'Sorge Field' shortly."
Miyasco: "I don't see anything unusual."
Celica: "It doesn't look like anything. But it's definitely there..."
Celica: "...See?"
Derock: "Don't just say 'See?'!
Those noises sound dangerous, you know.
It's so bright! We've got to do something, you know."
Celica: "I told you we'd be fine, didn't I?
Deploy protective field!"
Derock: "It feels like we're shaking even more than before, you know.
This is bad. I knew it wouldn't work!"
Celica: "I told you! There's nothing to worry about!
My 'Charge Buddy No. 3' is perfect!"
Sisk: "We made it through..."
Celica: "See? What did I tell you?"
Derock: "That's our Princess Celica!
I-I believed in you right from the start, you know."
Celica: "..."
Miyasco: "C-come to think of it, I haven't seen
Ymir around..."
Celica: "...If she still hasn't come back by now...
it seems things went well...
What... am I doing...?"
Miyasco: "Princess... Celica?"
Celica: "Huh? Y-yes, where could she have gone?"
Miyasco: "..."
Celica: "Anyway, it's about time I got ready
to deploy. I'll leave the rest to you."
Captain Roa: "Very well."
Derock: "Cheer up, Princess Celica.
Life has its ups and downs, you know.
That's what Ai said."
Celica: "Hmm. Some sort of saying? Well, never mind.
...Anyway, I never expected you to cheer me up, Derock.
I'm a little impressed."
Derock: "I'm on your side, Princess Celica.
Besides, romances born in unusual circumstances don't last.
And then, to seize that opening... Ghyuff! Ghyuff!"
Celica: "...I take it back."
Ymir: "..."
Sisk: "Oh..."
Celica: "Ymir..."
Ymir: "..."
Celica: "I see... Honestly, that idiot...
I'll go teach him a little lesson..."
Ymir: "...Thank you. But don't.
I'll stay here and protect the place he'll come back to.
That's enough for me..."
Celica: "Ymir..."
Ymir: "I'm sorry I'm late."
Celica: "Are you okay?"
Ymir: "Yes. Don't worry. Now is the time
to focus on the battle ahead. We can't afford distractions."
Celica: "I see... All right.
Well then, I'll be off for a bit."
Ymir: "Be careful."
Celica: "Leave it to me. See you!"
Ai: "Whaaaat?!"
Clovis: "Hey, are you serious?"
Fain: "Y-Ymir is going aboard Rayblade...?"
Arthur: "...She does seem to be serious."
Ymir: "Yes."
Kasumi: "Touya-chan, is that true?"
Touya: "Yeah."
Aurelie: "Well, if that's what you've decided, Touya,
it's not our place to argue.
Besides, seeing how close you two are, I can more or less guess."
Ymir: "Oh..."
Kasumi: "..."
Ai: "...Sigh. Well, I sort of saw it coming...
But you really did end up with Ymir."
Ymir: "E-end up together...?"
Ai: "Honestly, I can't believe I let this happen.
But this is up to the two of you.
Complaining would just make me look pathetic.
Fine, fine. I understand. I'll admit I've lost
and quietly step aside..."
Touya: "Ai... You..."
Aurelie: "Huh? Don't tell me...
you never noticed how Ai felt?!"
Ai: "Don't bother. He's about as perceptive as a primitive life-form.
Right, Kasumi?"
Kasumi: "Huh? W-well..."
Ai: "Why don't we two losers lick our wounds
and make our exit...? Okay?"
Kasumi: "Touya-chan... Do you really feel that way about Ymir...?"
Touya: "...Yeah."
Kasumi: "I-I see... I..."
Ai: "Okay, stop right there! We don't have time to mope over heartbreak.
Let's turn those feelings into anger
and take it out on them! Right, Kasumi?"
Kasumi: "...Y-you're right...
You're hurting too, Ai-chan...
I can't be the only one feeling sorry for myself..."
Touya: "Kasumi... Um..."
Kasumi: "Don't! You're so kind, Touya-chan...
If you say something like that to me now..."
Ai: "Come on, don't cry. Hold it in! Hold it in!
Let's forget that jerk as fast as we can.
Oh! Why don't you go out with me instead?"
Kasumi: "What?!"
Ai: "I've always thought you were
pretty nice, Kasumi."
Kasumi: "H-hey..."
Ai: "Oh, I forgot to mention,
I go to an all-girls school."
Kasumi: "A-Ai-chan... I'm not into girls...
W-well, I'll be going!"
Ai: "Oh! Wait for me!"
Touya: "...I had no idea Ai was like that..."
Touya: "Owww!! Wh-what the hell are you doing?!
Aaah! A-all right! Stop biting me!"
Yamato: "...Honestly...
Ai's the one who most wants to cry, you knyow?
She's forcing herself to joke around."
Touya: "Huh...?"
Ymir: "Ai..."
Clovis: "Well, they'd have found out eventually.
Maybe this was for the best."
Arthur: "It's easy to be liked by everyone,
but having no one dislike you
isn't the same as being liked by everyone."
Fain: "Touya. Normally, I'd make you
a stain on my blade for making Kasumi cry.
But I can't cut down the man Ymir loves.
Touya... Don't make Ymir cry.
If you do..."
Touya: "Yeah. If that happens, you can have my head
or anything else you want."
Fain: "Your eyes tell me you're not lying.
But... Why do you get all the girls...?"
Arthur: "Come now, it's fine.
Well then, shall we get going...?"
Gabon: "Hey, Touya! Have you seen Leone?"
Touya: "Huh? No, I haven't..."
Gabon: "I see... Where on earth could she..."
Touya: "H-hey, what do you mean, where? Has Leone disappeared?"
Gabon: "If you heard anything else in what I said,
you'd better get those ears replaced."
Yamato: "Forget that, nyow. Is it true
Leone's gone?"
Gabon: "Yeah. I thought she was sound asleep, so I went
to the kitchen for a bit. When I came back, the bed was empty.
I figured she'd probably be here..."
Yamato: "Touya, you don't think... she's inside Rayblade, nyow...?"
Touya: "...It's possible. All right, let's go up and see."
Leone: "Oh, you found me..."
Touya: "...Honestly, you..."
Yamato: "Gabon! She's up here!"
Gabon: "...Damn it! Get down here, now!"
Leone: "No."
Yamato: "She says no!"
Gabon: "...Sigh. I do understand
how you feel...
but think about your body!"
Yamato: "...That's what he says."
Leone: "No."
Touya: "Hey, come on..."
Yamato: "...Looks like it's nyo use!"
Gabon: "Wait there! I'm coming up!"
Touya: "...Listen, Leone..."
Leone: "Touya. I'm going to fight with you.
So take me along."
Touya: "Stop joking. Besides, your body's..."
Leone: "That's exactly why. I'm going to keep getting worse.
I might not be able to move around like this anymore.
So I want to spend whatever time I can with you while I can.
And you're going to fight my father, right?
Then I'll help. This is my problem too."
Yamato: "Are you physically up to it, nyow?"
Leone: "As you can see, I'm full of energy.
So please... Let me come with you..."
Gabon: "...Are you serious? Do you really mean that?"
Leone: "Yes. I don't want to have any regrets.
While I'm still okay... While I'm still alive..."
Touya: "Don't say things like that.
For now, just rest..."
Gabon: "Take her with you."
Yamato: "G-Gabon?!"
Gabon: "Even if we force her to stay here,
she might go out in Eleana next time.
She's still better off being with Touya than doing that."
Touya: "Well, maybe you're right, but..."
Leone: "I... I'm scared of being alone...
Of... ceasing to exist..."
Touya: "..."
Leone: "That's why I want you to let me stay with you.
If you're there, Touya, I feel like I can keep going."
Touya: "...All right. Leone, let's go together."
Leone: "...Yes!"
Yamato: "I hope this is the last time we have to board Rayblade."
Touya: "Yeah."
Yamato: "...Now, about your partner this time...
You understand, don't you?"
Touya: "Understand what?"
Yamato: "Don't give me that!
This time, you're choosing the person you really need,
the person you want beside you right to the end."
Touya: "The person I want beside me..."
Yamato: "Look, here they come.
Think it through and choose properly, nyow!"
Mechanic A: "All right! Once Rayblade launches,
the rest will launch in order!"
Mechanic C: "Huh? Touya and the others are already
aboard Rayblade, right? Why haven't they launched?"
Mechanic F: "...You're clueless too.
We can't go getting in the way of someone's romance, can we?"
Mechanic C: "...Oh, I see. Right.
A sweetheart, huh...? That's got nothing to do with me..."
Mechanic F: "...You really are clueless..."
Ai: "Touya, once this battle's over,
will we be able to go back to our own world?"
